title: Assumption
description: Governed cryptographic assumption, pinned to an exact Lean declaration in `formal-core` (`security/assumptions/<id>.json`).

lean_decl.description: Fully qualified Lean name of the hypothesis *definition* (a `Prop`-valued def in formal-core), e.g. `ArenaCore.Assumptions.Sha256CollisionResistant`.

lean_decl_digest.description: Structural content hash of the Lean declaration (lean4export NDJSON, `arena_formal_checker::ndjson::Export::decl_hash`, rendered `sha256:<hex>`; computed by `runners/formal-checker/scripts/pin-assumption-digests.sh`).
